verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a hardware system-on-chip, and self-hosting is a deployment model for software or services, so the story's axis does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence about running LLMs locally on M5 Macs (e.g., LM Studio, MLX) describes third-party software running on the chip, not a self-hostable version of the M5 itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
